title: Voice messages play in the Windows app
summary: The Windows app plays voice messages from the phones in the chat, as the Mac and Linux apps do, instead of opening them in the system's player. It now carries FFmpeg 8.1.1 built for it, like the Mac and Linux apps, in place of FFmpeg 4.4.8.
